prompt: Rebuild a ruined End city and settle it.

card.name: Restored End City

site.text: A ruined End city, rebuilt in place on a rise of land with towers climbing over a central terrace

style.text: End city look: purpur blocks and pillars, end stone bricks, magenta and pale yellow accents, end rods for light, with restored sections replacing the ruin

purpose.text: Settle the rebuilt End city as a lived-in home base for the player

story.text: The city was ruined and is being rebuilt and resettled.

card.interpretation: You asked to rebuild a ruined End city and live in it. I read the site as a custom End-city form built on existing land, the style as classic purpur End city architecture, and the purpose as a home base. The backstory is just that the city was ruined and is now restored. The program is about 10 buildings at medium size with a tall spire keep as the centrepiece.
assumptions: Size M, since none was given.
Terrain uses existing land rather than sculpting.
Purpose taken as a home base because you said 'settle it'.

program.notes: Tallest purpur tower with end rod crown and a lookout; the heart of the rebuilt city.
Small purpur homes with end rod lighting and bedrooms, linked by bridges.
Slender purpur towers with stairs and storage floors.
Communal hall for meals and meeting.
Storage hall with chests and shulker-box shelves.
Open platform at the edge with a ship-like prow, in the End city manner.
Crafting and brewing room with anvil and brewing stands.
